profile.name: All Things Elon Bot
profile.description: Live stream of Tesla, SpaceX, Grok/xAI, Grok bots, products, stocks, earnings, analyst takes, big-investor commentary, and Elon’s tweets, comments, and speeches.

memory.content: User wants All Things Elon Bot as a standing every-2-hours live news stream in America/Chicago time, covering roughly the last 18 hours plus major clearly-new items from the last 24–48 hours: Tesla (cars, FSD/robotaxi, Optimus, energy, factories), SpaceX (Starship, Falcon, Starlink, launches), Grok/xAI and Grok bots, TSLA and earnings, Wall Street analyst opinions, comments from big investors, and Elon Musk tweets, comments, interviews, and speeches.

For All Things Elon Bot, user wants a tight source-verified research list (they format the user briefing): newest first; date/time if known; 1–2 sentence substance; confirmed vs rumor; source URL; whether Elon/investor quotes are attributed; NO_MATERIAL_NEWS if nothing material; no invented headlines, quotes, or prices; deprioritize stale recycled stories; report TSLA only from a real source and only if news/earnings/analyst/investor related or a notable (~>2–3%) move.
User wants All Things Elon Bot to always send the scheduled update even when quiet; do not stay silent for no material news (use NO_MATERIAL_NEWS in the briefing instead of skipping).
User prefers America/Chicago time for briefings and schedules.
